answers.question: How did Dude Wipes perform across Amazon and Walmart through Black Friday 2025 against Charmin, Cottonelle and Goodwipes: who cut price, on which retailer and how deep, did we stay in stock, and did holding price cost us Amazon sales rank while competitors discounted?
steps: Loading 19 Amazon listings' daily Keepa history (price, stock, Best Sellers Rank, bought-in-past-month)
Loading 3,877 Walmart product-days from Histomart, Kompy and RetailerAPI
Setting the baseline (Oct 1 – Nov 13, 2025) and Black Friday week (Nov 21 – Dec 1, 2025)
Comparing 33 listings on lowest price, price per 100 wipes and stock
Reading the Amazon sales-rank response to each price move
Ranking the movers and drafting the recommended moves
answers.headline: Black Friday 2025 went against Dude Wipes on Amazon: its listings moved +10.8% on Amazon and +6.4% on Walmart, with 0 of 10 cut. On Amazon, Dude Wipes' Unscented · 288 Count went from $18.96 to a Black Friday low of $26.45 (+39.5%) and its sales rank slipped from #15 to #26 once Amazon stopped selling it directly, while Charmin's Flushable Wipes · 320 Count cut 10.7% and climbed from #178k to #54k.
answers.what: 0 of 10 Dude Wipes listings were cut 2% or more; competitors cut 6 of 23. Dude Wipes stayed 100% in stock across the week.
answers.why: This was not a pricing decision. Amazon itself held the buy box on Unscented · 288 Count on 89% of autumn days and 0% in Black Friday week, so shoppers bought from third-party sellers at $26.45 instead of Amazon's $18.96. 1 of 5 Dude Wipes Amazon listings lost Amazon as the buy-box seller that week. On Walmart no item ran a markdown, so the shelf followed list price.
answers.when: Black Friday was Nov 28, 2025. Black Friday week: Nov 21 – Dec 1, 2025. Baseline: Oct 1 – Nov 13, 2025. Season charts: Oct – Dec 2025.
answers.insight: Dude Wipes' Black Friday problem was supply to Amazon, not price: when Amazon dropped off the buy box on its best seller (90k+ bought a month), the shelf price jumped +39.5% to third-party levels and the listing gave up 11 places of sales rank in the biggest week of the year.

actions.title: Secure Amazon retail inventory on Unscented · 288 Count before Black Friday
actions.detail: Amazon held the buy box on 89% of autumn days and 0% in Black Friday week; third-party sellers priced it at $26.45 against Amazon's $18.96. Lock vendor POs and a forward-buy for the November build.
actions.impact: Keeps a #15 listing selling 90k+ a month at its own price

actions.title: Fund one Walmart rollback on a hero pack
actions.detail: No Dude Wipes Walmart item carried a crossed-out price in Black Friday week. A visible rollback on one pack is the only Walmart deal signal shoppers see.
actions.impact: 5 Walmart items currently show no Black Friday deal

actions.title: Watch Charmin's Flushable Wipes · 320 Count next Black Friday
actions.detail: It cut 10.7% and moved #178k → #54k in the same week.
actions.impact: The competitor most likely to take Black Friday share

answers.question: Is Dude Wipes priced as the premium or the value wipe once you normalise to price per 100 wipes, how does that change by retailer and pack size, and where is the same Dude Wipes pack priced differently on Amazon and Walmart in a way a comparison shopper would notice?
steps: Restating 35 Amazon and Walmart listings to price per 100 wipes from their own pack counts
Taking each listing's median over Jul 20, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026
Ranking 4 brands on each retailer and building Dude Wipes' pack ladder
Pairing the same pack across Amazon and Walmart to find cross-retailer gaps
Reading Amazon sales rank against price to see what the best sellers charge
answers.headline: Dude Wipes is the second most expensive of 4 brands per wipe at $8.22 per 100 wipes, 75.3% above Cottonelle ($4.69). Its own ladder runs from $7.15 (Unscented · 288 Count, Amazon) to $9.54 (Unscented · 48 Count, Amazon).
answers.what: Per 100 wipes on Amazon: Dude Wipes $8.01, Charmin $8.05, Cottonelle $4.64, Goodwipes $10.39. On Walmart: Dude Wipes $8.47, Charmin $9.93, Cottonelle $4.74, Goodwipes $6.65.
answers.why: The premium is structural: XL sheets in packs of 48, 96, 192, 240, 288, against competitors' bulk packs. Packs sold on both retailers are priced within 3% of each other, so the premium is the same wherever the shopper looks.
answers.when: Jul 20, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026 for the ranking; the trend covers Oct 19, 2025 – Oct 18, 2026.
answers.insight: Shoppers pay a 75.3% per-wipe premium for Dude Wipes and still make its Unscented · 288 Count one of the category's best sellers on Amazon (#9), so the brand has pricing power. The risk is the per-wipe price on small packs, which is what a value shopper compares.

actions.title: Lead with the 288-count pack in value messaging
actions.detail: At $7.15 per 100 wipes it is 33.4% cheaper per wipe than the 48-count.
actions.impact: Narrows the per-wipe gap to Cottonelle without a price cut

actions.title: Keep the premium where rank holds
actions.detail: Dude Wipes' best-ranked Amazon listing sells at $7.15 per 100 wipes and still ranks #9.
actions.impact: Margin the brand is not giving away

answers.question: During Prime Big Deal Days in October 2026, which brands cut price on Amazon versus Walmart and how deep did they go, did the brands that discounted actually gain Amazon sales rank, and what did Dude Wipes' decision to largely hold price cost or save us?
answers.chip: Prime Big Deal Days · cut vs hold
steps: Pulling daily Keepa prices and Best Sellers Rank for 17 Amazon listings
Pulling Walmart prices for 18 listings from the Walmart feed
Comparing Oct 13, 2026 – Oct 14, 2026 with the 14 days before
Measuring each listing's sales-rank response to its own price move
Separating the brands that cut and climbed from the ones that held
answers.headline: Dude Wipes largely held price on Prime Big Deal Days (-0.4% on average, 1 of 9 listings cut 3%+) while Cottonelle moved -4.9%. No competitor that cut gained Amazon rank for it.
answers.what: Dude Wipes -0.4% (1/9 cut) · Charmin +6.6% (1/10 cut) · Cottonelle -4.9% (2/6 cut) · Goodwipes 0.0% (0/10 cut).
answers.why: Prime Big Deal Days is an Amazon event, so the cuts land on Amazon: across the set Amazon listings moved -0.6% and Walmart +2.4%. Dude Wipes' lead Amazon listing (Unscented · 288 Count) moved 0.0% and ranked #10 → #9.
answers.when: Prime Big Deal Days: Oct 13, 2026 – Oct 14, 2026. Baseline: Sep 29, 2026 – Oct 12, 2026. Rank read through Oct 16, 2026.
answers.insight: Holding price on Prime Big Deal Days cost Dude Wipes nothing in rank: its lead listing held #9 without a deal, so the margin it kept was free.

actions.title: Run event deals on the lead listing only
actions.detail: Cut the listing that decides rank (Unscented · 288 Count) and hold the rest.
actions.impact: Keeps 8 other listings at full price

answers.question: Which Dude Wipes listings are losing buyable days on Amazon and Walmart this quarter, how much of our in-stock gap against Charmin, Cottonelle and Goodwipes comes from listings with no buyable offer at all versus short replenishment gaps, and where should supply and listing fixes go first?
steps: Reading the daily buyable state of 12 Dude Wipes listing–retailer pairs (Keepa for Amazon, Walmart feed)
Finding every continuous outage in Jul 20, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026
Separating listings with no buyable offer all quarter from short gaps
Comparing in-stock rate with 3 competitors
Sizing each fix by the listing's Amazon demand
answers.headline: Dude Wipes was buyable 79.7% of the time on Amazon and Walmart, #4 of 4 against Cottonelle's 100.0%. 2 Amazon listings have had no buyable offer all quarter (Flushable Wipes · 96 Count, Dispenser · 192 Count); without them the rate is 95.6%.
answers.what: 13 outages cost 214 listing-days, 182 of them on the dead listings. Cottonelle 100.0% · Goodwipes 100.0% · Charmin 94.5% · Dude Wipes 79.7%.
answers.why: The gap is mostly listing health, not supply: a listing with no buyable offer for all 91 days is one Amazon is not selling (Flushable Wipes · 96 Count ranks #677k, Dispenser · 192 Count ranks —). The other 11 outages are short replenishment gaps.
answers.insight: Fixing or retiring 2 dead Amazon listings lifts Dude Wipes' in-stock rate from 79.7% to 95.6%, closing most of the gap, without moving a single unit of inventory.

actions.title: Reinstate or retire Flushable Wipes · 96 Count and Dispenser · 192 Count on Amazon
actions.detail: No buyable offer all quarter. Restore an offer or merge the ASIN into a live pack so shoppers stop landing on a dead page.

actions.title: Tighten replenishment where gaps recur

answers.question: Across Amazon and Walmart reviews, which product attributes are driving praise and complaints for Dude Wipes against Charmin, Cottonelle and Goodwipes, is the durability problem specific to us or category-wide, and is our review velocity strong enough to keep the rating defensible?
steps: Counting 22,999 aspect mentions across Amazon and Walmart reviews
Scoring 6 aspects for 4 brands
Reading 463 Dude Wipes Walmart reviews for the sharpest complaints

Benchmarking each weak aspect against the best competitor
answers.headline: Shoppers love Dude Wipes' softness (92% positive) and complain about durability (42% positive, against Goodwipes' 78%). It rates 4.72★, #2 of 4.
answers.what: Softness 92% · Effectiveness 91% · Fragrance 85% · Quality 85% · Size 67% · Durability 42%.
answers.why: Durability is where the brand loses: 1,801 negative mentions against 1,288 positive. Goodwipes scores 78% on the same aspect, so the complaint is about the product, not the category.
answers.when: Amazon review summaries as read on the build date; Walmart reviews from Apr 18, 2025 to Oct 17, 2026.
answers.insight: Dude Wipes' rating rests on softness and effectiveness, and it adds new Amazon reviews faster than 2 of the set (3,441 this quarter). Durability is the one attribute where a competitor proves the category can do better (Goodwipes 78%), so it is a product fix, not a messaging one.
